Discord Rich Presence for AI coding tools, on Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Install

**macOS:** [Download AgentPresence-macOS.dmg](https://github.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/releases/latest/download/AgentPresence-macOS.dmg), open it, double-click **Agent Presence**, click **Install**. Already installed? Open the new app and click **Update**.

**Linux / macOS terminal**
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.sh | bash
```
**Windows** (PowerShell)
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abelxmendoza/discord-agent-presence/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## New since v0.9.0

* **Computers on different networks share one card.** Linked computers that both run `web setup` with the same repo now swap their status through it, encrypted with your link key, so a laptop away from home still counts toward the card. Same-network computers work as before.
* **One web status for all your computers.** The README card and website widget are published by the computer you're using, among those set up to publish, instead of going quiet when the Discord card moves to a computer that doesn't publish.
* **GitHub profile and linking in the Mac app.** Open the app and click **More…** to show your status on your GitHub profile and website, or to link your other computers with a key. No terminal needed.
* `agent-presence machines` also checks the repo and says which computer publishes the web card. `link --print-key` prints just the key; `web setup --yes` skips the GitHub CLI prompt.
